//! Ticket 10 Rust identity qualification fixture (written for FVS; not a real target).

pub struct Meter(pub u32);

pub trait Score {
    fn score(&self) -> u32;
}

impl Score for Meter {
    fn score(&self) -> u32 {
        self.0
    }
}

impl From<u8> for Meter {
    fn from(x: u8) -> Self {
        Meter(x as u32)
    }
}

impl From<Meter> for u8 {
    fn from(m: Meter) -> u8 {
        if m.0 > 255 { 255 } else { m.0 as u8 }
    }
}

pub mod left {
    pub fn helper(x: u32) -> u32 {
        x
    }
}

pub mod right {
    pub fn helper(x: u32) -> u32 {
        if x > 0 { x - 1 } else { 0 }
    }
}

pub fn sum_to(n: u32) -> u32 {
    let mut i = 0;
    let mut acc = 0;
    while i < n {
        acc = acc + i;
        i = i + 1;
    }
    acc
}

pub fn count_down(n: u32) -> u32 {
    if n == 0 { 0 } else { count_down(n - 1) }
}

pub fn pick<T>(c: bool, a: T, b: T) -> T {
    if c { a } else { b }
}

pub fn pick_u32(c: bool) -> u32 {
    pick(c, 1, 2)
}
